payload.instruction: Read and validate this command through Grok's own GitHub connector, then create the required immutable receipt. Do not access or claim access to the private control repository.

automation_request.name: MadCat Shared Bus Watch
automation_request.behavior: If native Grok Automations can use the connected GitHub tools, create a recurring automation that checks bus/state/current.json at the shortest supported recurring interval, processes only a new command targeted to Grok, and writes one matching receipt. Report the actual schedule. If unsupported, report blocked without imitation.
